description: Company job boards for the shared catalog (focus: Germany, Turkey, remote). Every entry is an unverified candidate until POST /admin/catalog/boards/{id}/check or `sync_catalog check` reads it live; seeding adds them disabled. Do not mark an entry verified without a successful live check.
